title: Supreme Court Rescues Arbitration Limitation Clock From Maintainability Trap
description: A Procedural Nightmare Finally Laid to Rest Ask any arbitration practitioner who has managed a post-award correction under Section 33 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, and they will describe the same dilemma. A Section 33 application has been filed. The tribunal is considering it. Limitation under Section 34(3) is ticking. Does the party wait for the tribunal to dispose of the application, or does it simultaneously file a Section 34(1) petition in court, purely as a safeguard agains
